hypothesis: At least 10% of structurally substitutable, nonempty-answer Full units have a non-SQL-used FK mapping whose replacement produces the same result bag on the frozen BIRD database instance.

transformation.target: one explicit JOIN-ON alias pair with exactly one SQL-used canonical FK mapping
transformation.allowed_predicates: direct qualified column equalities in the top-level AND conjunction
transformation.operation: replace all target mapping column equalities as one bundle; preserve every other JOIN-ON term and the rest of the SQL AST
unsupported_cases: zero or multiple matching JOIN alias groups
target equality nested under OR or a non-column expression
missing or duplicate target equality term

decision.smoke_gate: All 5 Smoke units must be structurally substitutable; every original Gold SQL and every candidate variant must execute under the read-only evaluator; the SQL-used target replay must match the original Gold result in both Set and Bag comparison, with identical output columns.
decision.full_gate: At least 80 of 108 Full units must have complete candidate results, spanning at least 3 anonymous databases; otherwise report insufficient coverage and stop.
decision.positive_signal: At least 10% of complete nonempty-answer Full units have an alternative mapping with Bag equality to the original Gold SQL result.
decision.weak_signal: At most 5% of complete nonempty-answer Full units have such an alternative.
decision.inconclusive: The primary rate is greater than 5% and less than 10%, or the full coverage gate is not met.
decision.stop: Do not alter the SQL sample, FK candidate set, mapping identities, query skeleton, SQL evaluator, or thresholds; do not call more reviewers or rank GFM in this experiment.

interpretation_limit: Same execution output on one static database instance is not a proof of semantic equivalence or business-role correctness. This audit does not establish human labels or evaluate G-reasoner ranking.

amendment.reason: The original Full runner aborted when a selected unit declared zero or multiple SQL-used mapping IDs, although the registered protocol classifies that structure as unsupported and calls for reporting insufficient coverage.
amendment.scope: Keep the frozen sample, candidate set, SQL transformation, read-only evaluator, limits, thresholds, and hypothesis unchanged. Record unsupported target cardinality per unit. Emit aggregate results when Full coverage is insufficient.
